reasoning_content: Since we've reset everything, we now need to restart and see what's the real status. The server should boot but throw the SUPABASE_URL error since we reset index.ts.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check original errors
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pkill -f 'tsx src' 2>&1 || true")

time.sleep(2)

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && nohup npx tsx src/index.ts > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &")

time.sleep(15)

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -15 /tmp/server.log")
print("Log:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
